# AbstractAgent (full)

> Expanded map of docs + source files for LLM-assisted understanding and maintenance.

This repo is a Python package (`abstractagent`) that implements agent workflows as:
1) pure logic (prompting/parsing, no runtime imports),
2) runtime adapters (logic → `WorkflowSpec` with durable `EffectType.*` steps),
3) thin agent API wrappers (`BaseAgent` + concrete agents).

This file is a *larger* index than `llms.txt` (more source files + tests). It is not an official part of the `llms.txt` spec,
but is commonly used as a “bigger context window” companion.

Important notes (source-of-truth hints):
- Runtime behavior lives in workflow adapters: `src/abstractagent/adapters/*_runtime.py`
- Keep prompting/parsing runtime-agnostic: `src/abstractagent/logic/*` (no `abstractruntime` imports)
- `src/abstractagent/adapters/generation_params.py` is the shared LLM param normalizer for temperature, seed, media policy, prompt-cache identity, streaming passthrough (`_runtime.stream`), Core `thinking` and `speculation` (MTP). Delegated children in ReAct, CodeAct and MemAct inherit `stream`, `speculation`, `thinking`, provider/model, sampling, `max_output_tokens`, `tool_prompt_examples` and `tool_policy` (see `docs/architecture.md`).
- `src/abstractagent/adapters/loop_hooks.py` is the shared loop-hook layer (listen/steer/capture); see `docs/hooks.md`.
- Docs entrypoint: `README.md` → `docs/getting-started.md` → `docs/README.md`
- Version 0.3.17 requires `abstractcore[tools]>=2.13.41` and `AbstractRuntime>=0.7.0`; extras: `apple`, `gpu`, `test`, `dev`.
- The loops stamp the runtime turn-grounding envelope into the durable user turn once (`abstractruntime.turn_grounding`) and place the loop tail with `transcripts.place_loop_tail`, keeping prompts byte-prefix stable across iterations and turns.
- MemAct is not re-exported at the package top-level; import from `abstractagent.agents.memact` (see `docs/api.md`).
- After changes, run tests: `pytest -q` (`python -P -m pytest -q` from a folder with sibling checkouts)

## Source tree

- [Package init](src/abstractagent/__init__.py): Top-level exports

- [BaseAgent](src/abstractagent/agents/base.py): lifecycle + persistence + ledger access
- [ReAct agent](src/abstractagent/agents/react.py): `ReactAgent`, `create_react_agent`
- [CodeAct agent](src/abstractagent/agents/codeact.py): `CodeActAgent`, `create_codeact_agent`
- [MemAct agent](src/abstractagent/agents/memact.py): `MemActAgent`, `create_memact_agent`

- [ReAct workflow adapter](src/abstractagent/adapters/react_runtime.py): `create_react_workflow`
- [CodeAct workflow adapter](src/abstractagent/adapters/codeact_runtime.py): `create_codeact_workflow`
- [MemAct workflow adapter](src/abstractagent/adapters/memact_runtime.py): `create_memact_workflow`

- [LLM param normalization](src/abstractagent/adapters/generation_params.py): temperature/seed/audio policies, prompt-cache identity, streaming passthrough (`_runtime.stream`), Core `thinking` and `speculation`, `context_usage_warning`; verifier execution grounding (`EXECUTOR_TAGS`/`executor_tool_names`/`verifier_execution_preference` — tools declaring tags=["executor"] are named in verifier prompts with "unexecuted is unverified"); lane-honest guidance wrappers (`guidance_wrapper` — visit lanes under `suppress_loop_tail` get host-voiced attribution, task lane byte-unchanged)
- [Transcripts](src/abstractagent/adapters/transcripts.py): provider-safe transcript sanitation, tool-call id stamping (`ensure_tool_call_ids`, `synthetic_call_id`), loop-tail placement (`place_loop_tail`)
- [Native-loop registry](src/abstractagent/adapters/native_loop_registry.py): `audit_native_loop_manifest`, `materialize_native_loop_spec`, `build_native_loop_manifest`, `pack_native_loop_bundle` (gateway `.flow` bundles)
- [Loop hooks](src/abstractagent/adapters/loop_hooks.py): `LoopHooks`, `HookEvent`, `DEFAULT_EVENT_MAP` (listen/steer/capture)
- [Circling detection](src/abstractagent/adapters/progress.py): `circling_streak` — pure read-only near-restatement detector over recent outputs (0017 detector half; policy-free, host-consumable)
- [Emit-step inventory](src/abstractagent/adapters/emit_inventory.py): declared per-adapter raw step names (drift-tested; stability contract in docs/hooks.md)
- [Factory defaults](src/abstractagent/agents/defaults.py): provider/model resolution (AbstractCore config global defaults; loud `#FALLBACK` packaged pair)
- [Unattended recipe](src/abstractagent/agents/unattended.py): `unattended_runtime_overrides` / `unattended_allowlist` (exclude `ask_user` + no-questions directive)
- [Task reset](src/abstractagent/agents/task_reset.py): `reset_react_task(vars, task, carry_messages=, handoff_note=)` — between-runs vars transform for queued work: per-task state resets (scratchpad/_temp/counters/steering inbox), door-owned `_runtime` persists (deep-copied), messages carry by default; input never mutated
- [Tool allowlist notes](src/abstractagent/adapters/tool_allowlist.py): loud pruning of unresolvable grants (`allowlist_pruned`)
- [Attachment/media plumbing](src/abstractagent/adapters/media.py): `extract_media_from_context`

- [ReAct logic](src/abstractagent/logic/react.py): `ReActLogic` (system prompt + response parsing)
- [CodeAct logic](src/abstractagent/logic/codeact.py): `CodeActLogic` (python-block extraction)
- [MemAct logic](src/abstractagent/logic/memact.py): `MemActLogic`
- [Built-in tool schemas](src/abstractagent/logic/builtins.py): schema-only tool definitions
- [Logic types](src/abstractagent/logic/types.py): `LLMRequest` dataclass

- [Default tools bundle](src/abstractagent/tools/__init__.py): `ALL_TOOLS`
- [execute_python tool](src/abstractagent/tools/code_execution.py): `execute_python`
- [self_improve tool](src/abstractagent/tools/self_improve.py): local JSONL logging
- [Local sandbox](src/abstractagent/sandbox/local.py): subprocess execution with timeout

- [Deprecated CLI](src/abstractagent/repl.py): `react-agent` entrypoint (migration hint)

- [ReAct max-iterations conclusion](tests/test_react_max_iterations_concludes.py)
- [delegate_agent behavior](tests/test_react_delegate_agent_tool.py)

- [CodeAct logic](tests/test_codeact_logic.py)
- [CodeAct verifier policy](tests/test_codeact_runtime_verifier_policy.py)
- [MemAct workflow](tests/test_memact_workflow.py)
- [MemAct session memory](tests/test_memact_session_memory.py)
- [Loop hooks contract](tests/test_loop_hooks.py)
- [Prompt prefix stability](tests/test_react_prompt_prefix_stability.py)
- [Phase-grant boundary](tests/test_react_phase_grant_boundary.py)
- [Entity dress conformance](tests/test_react_entity_dress_conformance.py)
- [Verifier failure containment](tests/test_review_failure_containment.py): absorbed review/finalize failures degrade to accept
- [Emit-inventory drift](tests/test_emit_inventory_drift.py): declared step names match emit call sites
- [Visit-workflow merge (caller side)](tests/test_react_visit_merge.py): `ReactMiddle` built from the public API
- [Plain tool observation](tests/test_react_act_only_observation.py): served content rests plainly; the retired `$act_only` ref layer stays dead (resurrection guard)
- [Gated-remainder wave pins](tests/test_gated_remainder_wave_2026_07_14.py): A1 fence gate, `read_skill`, side-effect classifier, `reset_react_task`, parse common core, turn-boundary resets
- [Audit-residue claim pins](tests/test_claim_0029_residue_2026_07_14.py): explicit budgets beat defaults, honest budget terminals, compose spin guard, marked truncation, repeat-guard bookkeeping, steering discard on failed runs
- [0026 follow-up pins](tests/test_loop_hooks_0026_follow_ups.py): 3-loop `init`/`tool_proposed` parity, `inbox_undelivered` terminal honesty, conclusion both-halves, composition-handoff exemption
- [prompt-cache telemetry pins](tests/test_parse_prompt_cache_capture.py): additive `parse.prompt_cache` struct surfaced when the provider reports one, absent otherwise
- [circling detector](tests/test_progress_detection.py): restatement runs detected, progress unflagged, oscillation via windowing, fences/markers excluded, short outputs transparent
- [verifier execution preference](tests/test_verifier_execution_preference.py): executor-tag classification, prompt byte-identity without the tag, forced-probe execution end-to-end, review-budget bound (forced batches never re-arm; model activity still does)
- [stuck-streak termination](tests/test_stuck_streak_termination.py): 3 identical batches / A-B-A-B oscillation force the named conclusion (0017 work half); interleaved work clean, knob disable, visit-lane chrome-free, turn fence
- [visit-lane honesty pins](tests/test_c2447_visit_lane_honesty.py): 3-loop tail suppression, tools_ran capture, turn-fenced repeat guard, chrome-free conclusions, lane-honest guidance wrappers (task byte-identity + visit wrapper + metadata anchor)
